# iru_tag (Resource)

Manages an Iru Tag, used to organize and scope devices, blueprints, and library items.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iru_tag" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = iru_tag.engineering
  identity = {
    id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the object in Iru.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = iru_tag.engineering
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Tags are imported by their ID.
terraform import iru_tag.engineering 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
